STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_096824.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_096824.v · Open raw
module origen_096824 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire nmi,
    output reg [2:0] address,
    output reg [7:0] ppu_data,
    output reg ppu_rw,
    output reg ppu_cs
);

    // State encoding
    localparam IDLE = 4'd0,
               WRITE_FINE_X_SCROLL = 4'd1,
               WAIT_4 = 4'd2,
               WRITE_NEXT_BYTE = 4'd3,
               WAIT_3 = 4'd4,
               WRITE_SPR_Y_ADDR = 4'd5,
               WAIT_0 = 4'd6,
               WRITE_SPR_Y = 4'd7,
               WAIT_1 = 4'd8,
               WRITE_SPR_X_ADDR = 4'd9,
               WAIT_2 = 4'd10,
               WRITE_SPR_X = 4'd11;

    reg [3:0] state, next_state;
    reg [7:0] spr_x [0:199];
    reg [7:0] spr_y [0:199];
    reg [7:0] fine_scroll;
    reg [7:0] sprite_index;
    reg nmi_prev;

    initial begin
        $readmemh("spr_x.mem", spr_x);
        $readmemh("spr_y.mem", spr_y);
    end

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            state <= IDLE;
            fine_scroll <= 8'd0;
            sprite_index <= 8'd0;
            nmi_prev <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            state <= next_state;
            nmi_prev <= nmi;
            if (state == IDLE && nmi && !nmi_prev) begin
                fine_scroll <= fine_scroll + 1'b1;
                sprite_index <= 8'd0;
            end else if (state == WRITE_SPR_X) begin
                sprite_index <= sprite_index + 1'b1;
            end
        end
    end

    always @(*) begin
        next_state = state;
        address = 3'b000;
        ppu_data = 8'b0;
        ppu_rw = 1'b1;
        ppu_cs = 1'b1;

        case (state)
            IDLE:
                if (nmi && !nmi_prev) next_state = WRITE_FINE_X_SCROLL;
            WRITE_FINE_X_SCROLL: begin
                address = 3'b101;
                ppu_data = {fine_scroll[7:3], 3'b000};
                ppu_cs = 1'b0;
                next_state = WAIT_4;
            end
            WAIT_4:
                next_state = WRITE_NEXT_BYTE;
            WRITE_NEXT_BYTE: begin
                address = 3'b101;
                ppu_data = {3'b000, fine_scroll[7:3]};
                ppu_cs = 1'b0;
                next_state = WAIT_3;
            end
            WAIT_3:
                next_state = WRITE_SPR_Y_ADDR;
            WRITE_SPR_Y_ADDR: begin
                address = 3'b011;
                ppu_data = {sprite_index, 1'b0};
                ppu_cs = 1'b0;
                next_state = WAIT_0;
            end
            WAIT_0:
                next_state = WRITE_SPR_Y;
            WRITE_SPR_Y: begin
                address = 3'b100;
                ppu_data = spr_y[sprite_index];
                ppu_cs = 1'b0;
                next_state = WAIT_1;
            end
            WAIT_1:
                next_state = WRITE_SPR_X_ADDR;
            WRITE_SPR_X_ADDR: begin
                address = 3'b011;
                ppu_data = {sprite_index, 1'b1};
                ppu_cs = 1'b0;
                next_state = WAIT_2;
            end
            WAIT_2:
                next_state = WRITE_SPR_X;
            WRITE_SPR_X: begin
                address = 3'b100;
                ppu_data = spr_x[sprite_index];
                ppu_cs = 1'b0;
                next_state = (sprite_index == 8'd199) ? IDLE : WRITE_SPR_Y_ADDR;
            end
        endcase
    end

endmodule
